mentions.name: Stained Glass Atlas
mentions.description: A crowd-sourced map documenting publicly viewable stained glass, where anyone can add stained glass locations from their area. Built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on documenting all of the publicly available stained glass possible. No fancy tech, just vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. If you know of stained glass in your area, please add it to the map!

https://stainedglassatlas.com/
